title: nan
authors: Akhihiero D.; Olawoye U.; Das S.; Gross J.
key_contribution: Presents a cooperative air-ground architecture where a UGV uses 3D LiDAR, UWB, and UAV proprioceptive sensors to map subterranean environments and compare EKF vs factor graph UAV localization.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
